claims: The 2026 FIFA World Cup qualifiers are underway.
2026 FIFA World Cup qualifiers are scheduled through 2025 across all confederations.
UEFA matches for the 2026 FIFA World Cup qualifiers continue in March 2025.
The final two UEFA spots for the 2026 FIFA World Cup will be determined in a play-off tournament in March 2026.
UEFA European Qualifiers Matchday 1 is on 21–22 March 2025.
Wales vs. Kazakhstan is scheduled for March 24–25, 2025 in UEFA European Qualifiers.
Moldova vs. Norway is scheduled for March 24–25, 2025 in UEFA European Qualifiers.
Israel vs. Estonia is scheduled for March 24–25, 2025 in UEFA European Qualifiers.
UEFA European Qualifiers Group Stage continues on June 6–7, 2025.
Concacaf Qualifiers Second Round matches are continuing for the 2026 FIFA World Cup.
The play-off tournament finals for the 2026 FIFA World Cup are in March 2026.
The 2026 FIFA World Cup play-off tournament includes two Concacaf teams.
The 2026 FIFA World Cup play-off tournament includes one AFC team.
The 2026 FIFA World Cup play-off tournament includes one CAF team.
The 2026 FIFA World Cup play-off tournament includes one CONMEBOL team.
The 2026 FIFA World Cup play-off tournament includes one OFC team.
The host nations for the 2026 FIFA World Cup are Canada, Mexico, USA.
The 2026 FIFA World Cup dates are June 11 to July 19, 2026.
